title: The Quiet Made in the Next Room
youtube_title: The Quiet Made in the Next Room | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Remembering a kindness is a way of returning it.
summary: At a harbor shelter on the lee side of the wind, Sable notices that Neighbor Sami has already taken care of a quiet made in the next room while you practiced. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Sable does one useful thing Neighbor Sami did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
